recorded_arms: each arm independently records and seals its own P0; read first installed P1 query only
selection: all permanent native CDCL births in ascending ProofId whose original proof survives and whose full conclusion has a signed translation; no length or count cap
normalization: sort signed literals; remove repeated literals; reject tautologies, batch duplicates, root-satisfied clauses and exact resident residual duplicates; root units enqueue and propagate, ordinary clauses enter the reducible learnt database
metrics: unfiltered wall time for complete P0 and P1 processes, including source hashing, manifest capture, signed mapping/delta, receipt binding, reverse traversal, import, receipts and verification; native search timer surrounds restart loop
stock_search_observer: separate timer-only upstream process on each P1 with native counts/properties checked; primary stock wall/counters always from unmodified locked ELF
cache: new process, new work directory for each side and arm; OS caches unmanaged
